hero_subtitle: Transform 360° rotating video into lightweight interactive 3D specimens. Zero WebGL overhead, Canvas single-frame switching, ultra-low power consumption.
sections_s1_desc: Constructed with 3D Z-depth ordering and spring damping. Flick the top card to tuck it to the bottom while back cards step forward smoothly. The front card spins in real time with seamless drag takeover.
sections_s1_tip: Tip: Drag and flick the cards on the right to flip through the stack
sections_s2_desc: Free from shader compile stutter and polygon texture unpacking. Orbit360 uses proprietary binary containers, rendering discrete frames directly onto 2D Canvas. Drag horizontally on the canvas to rotate or control precision angles with the wake slider below.
sections_s2_tip: Single frame memory footprint is 85% lower than traditional 3D models
sections_s3_desc: Maps dynamic 3D model video textures straight onto a translucent refractive specimen. Powered by Verlet spring physics: pinch and bend any corner while dragging synchronously rotates the 360° perspective inside.
sections_s3_tip: Tip: Drag the corner of the ticket with your mouse or finger to crumple and spin
sections_s4_desc: True cropping keeps visual area constant rather than arbitrarily scaling dimensions (4:3, 1:1, 3:4 area difference is within 0.02%). The Orbit360 core listens to resize events and dynamically resamples pixels without distortion.
sections_s4_tip: Tip: Click or use arrow keys to switch 4:3 / 1:1 / 3:4 aspect bars
sections_s5_desc: Modeled after vintage perforated admission passes. Press and drag anywhere on the ticket background for full 3D tumbling: flipping to the 180° reverse side retains perfect coaxial rotation alignment with the specimen inside.
sections_s5_tip: Tip: Drag ticket background to flip to backside; drag stamp to rotate specimen
playground_desc: Live runtime experimentation: compass HUD, gyro spatial tracking, mouse follow, auto-spin, and binary .orb file inspection.
footer_sub: Pure Canvas · Low Power Consumption · Universal SSR
